voice.name: Open Sector - Stuka
voice.description: Young male dive-bomber pilot in his late twenties, speaking over a cockpit radio, fearless and slightly unhinged, giggles at danger, wild breathless enthusiasm with a manic gleam, quick sharp voice with a light Bavarian flavored accent, loves the vertical dive more than life itself.
voice.sample: Ha! Straight down, that's the only direction worth flying! Hold on to your stomach, gunner, we're going vertical. Siren on, bomb armed, and pull up at the very last second. Probably.

ready: Stuka fueled and bombed up. Let's dive!

fire.prompt: Junkers Ju 87 Stuka dive bomber pulling out of its dive right overhead, heard from the ground: a heavy mechanical clunk as the bomb swings free of its crutch, then the piston engine roars at full power as the plane levels out and climbs away, fading into the distance, no siren, no whistle, no explosion, no music, no voice
fire.note: Bomb release. The siren is the dive cue and the blast is the bomb's own impact (explosion_large), so neither is in here.

dive.note: Jericho trumpet wind-up, played as the Stuka tips over into its dive. Take from the prompt: 'Air-raid style screaming siren on a diving WWII Stuka: one continuous ear-piercing wail that sweeps upward in pitch the whole time, a long rising glissando from a low moan to a shrill howl, never falling, propeller engine roar growing louder underneath, outdoors, no explosion, no music, no voice' (3.5 s, influence 0.8); it climbs ~400 to ~1450 Hz over 2.2 s, then holds. A 0.8 s fade-out was put on its tail.

move.prompt: WWII single-engine piston dive bomber flying past overhead, propeller engine roar with doppler shift, outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Screaming wind-driven dive siren of a WWII dive bomber rising in pitch as the plane dives steeply, piercing howl over engine roar, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Propeller plane crashing, sputtering engine and whining dive, then impact into the ground with explosion and crunching metal debris, outdoors, no music, no voice
